summary: Verify narrow-purpose client results and persist terminal and bounded rejected-attempt receipts

replay.detail: Command rows remain ephemeral; separate trusted receipt claims preserve completed, expired, not-foreground and refused outcomes.

schema.detail: Commands carry grant/run metadata and signed results bind the generated visible-state model. Receipt claims contain command, issuer, device, run/grant and verified signature/binding, with null signatures for unsigned outcomes.

rules.detail: Daemon clock and live grant/claim checks gate enrolled P-256 results. Wrong key, purpose, kind, session, grant, run, command and replay are refused; message.send remains unauthorized with the same key/grant. Authenticated fixture-agent admission refusals receive durable receipt IDs; malformed, unauthenticated and non-fixture attempts do not. The 2048-row five-minute window returns receipt-capacity at saturation.

compatibility.detail: Restores device.command/device.result routes and session-scoped commands collection integration in the split API, including grant lifecycle resources and paired Unix fixture clients. Existing ordinary person-operated command shapes remain supported.

downtime.detail: No live setup, enrollment, daemon restart, deployment or journey is performed.

manual.detail: Source verification uses local temporary fixtures only; human setup/apply/enrollment gates remain separate.

recovery.detail: Receipt writes are idempotent per command and survive correlation eviction; missing persistence never silently drops an unsigned terminal receipt.
